name: Crab Penalty
description: Step into the sandy arena of Crab Penalty, where you take on the challenge of scoring goals with an unlikely yet charming player— a crab! Set on a picturesque beach, this fun and engaging game combines the thrill of penalty shooting with the unique twist of controlling a crab. Aim carefully and use your skills to outsmart the goalie, ensuring your crab kicks the ball into the net. Whether you're playing solo or competing with friends, Crab Penalty offers endless entertainment and a delightful seaside adventure.
